display_long_description:
A Secret Society Is Watching. Can You See What Others Don’t?
Step into the mind of Sherlock Holmes and unravel a conspiracy hidden behind a series of brutal murders. A secret society operates in the shadows - manipulating events from behind the scenes - and you are the only one who can expose it.
Now available worldwide with full multi-language support and major gameplay improvements.
Explore richly detailed hidden object scenes across iconic locations such as Sherlock’s study, Baker Street, a grand old mansion, a foggy dock, and a lively pub. Each case draws you deeper into a world of deception, where every object may conceal a crucial piece of evidence.
Designed specifically for VR, combining intuitive interactions with precise, hands-on investigation mechanics:
 • Use ray-based precision to search for clues
 • Switch between word hints, image clues, and grouped items
 • Use hints when you need a nudge
With Holmes’s legendary tools - magnifying glass, fingerprint scanner, and chemical analyzer - analyze evidence, solve complex deductions, and outsmart your suspects.
• Fully voiced suspects with branching, choice-driven dialogues
• Engaging case design with unique locations and characters
• Designed for comfort - play seated or in room-scale
Can you uncover the truth others cannot see?
